literal: Meaning devoid-of, even forgetting they will not speak, delusion freed-from, blemish without vision-they.
translation: Those of flawless vision, freed from delusion, will not speak meaningless words even in a moment of forgetfulness.
modern: மயக்கம் நீங்கிய குற்றமற்ற அறிவை உடையவர்கள், மறந்துபோய்க்கூடப் பயனில்லாத சொற்களைச் சொல்ல மாட்டார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the deep discipline of the wise regarding their speech. The phrase 'மருள் தீர்ந்த மாசறு காட்சியவர்' describes individuals whose understanding is perfectly clear, completely free from confusion and flaws. Because their minds are so pure, they will not utter words devoid of substance ('பொருள் தீர்ந்த'), even in a careless moment of forgetfulness ('பொச்சாந்தும்'). It shows that speaking purposefully is an unbreakable habit for those with true clarity.
